editorial:
Imagine being the most famous woman in the country, with every eye on you, yet feeling like nobody actually knows you. You follow Miroslava, a glamorous movie star who has everything money can buy but feels completely empty inside. The story takes place on her final night, and as she gets ready to end her life, you get a peek into her past. It is a heavy mood, but it feels very real. You see the gap between her sparkling public image and the lonely, sad person she is when the cameras stop rolling.

The acting is the best part here because you really feel her pain. While the pace is a bit slow at times, it makes the emotional hits land harder. If you like stories about the dark side of fame, you will love this. Since it is an older film, you should try to find a restored version. It is a sad ride, but it is worth it for the strong performances.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you see the full tragedy of her life. After flashing back through her failed relationships and the pressure of being a star, she finally follows through with her plan. She dies alone in her room, surrounded by the luxury that never actually made her happy. The movie ends by showing that her death was the only way she felt she could escape the fake world she lived in.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character studies and stories about the price of fame.
